title: AdapterManifest
description: What an adapter package declares about itself, read by core and never by the adapter: which roles it implements and which rqunit.toml keys it reads. Role wiring is checked before an exec can fail, and passthrough config gets its typo detection. Keys grow by demand, never speculatively — per-run family coverage already lives in the artifact's own `covers`.

stack.description: The stack this adapter serves. Must match the [stacks.<name>] table that points at it — a manifest wired to the wrong stack would validate the wrong vocabulary.

roles.description: Roles this adapter implements. A role declared in rqunit.toml but absent here is a wiring error worth surfacing before the exec fails.

config_keys.description: The [stacks.<name>] passthrough keys this adapter reads. Core validates consumer config against this list: a passthrough key in neither the core-interpreted set nor here is a typo, and a typo silently ignored would read as configured.
